Diagnosis names Deployment/vigil-app, not deployment/kube-prometheus-stack-grafana in the monitoring namespace.

It describes vigil-app readiness failures and replica shortfall, not Grafana being unschedulable due to a nonexistent nodeSelector.

relationship.evidence: One root cause: floating nginx image causes IPv6-only listening, readiness probe timeouts, and insufficient ready replicas.

diagnosis_text:
Diagnosis 1:
 root_cause: The declared vigl-app Deployment spec declares the nginx container's image as the floating tag `nginx:stable`, which currently resolves to nginx 1.30.8 whose default.conf is served on IPv6-only listen (container's /healthz request to 10.250.131.5:80 times out), so the readiness probe never succeeds and the Deployment stays below its expected replica count; the manifest's image reference is not pinned even though Git is otherwise correct. root_cause_component: Deployment/vigil-app
 recommended_action: flux_reconcile
 manifest_path: infra/overlays/hetzner/kubernetes/clusters/hetzner/apps/vigil-app.yaml
